hero.title: About us
hero.subtitle: We connect generations to build stronger homes and communities in Ourense.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.text1: Sempre na Casa was created to address two problems that, together, become an opportunity: unwanted loneliness among many older people and the difficulty young people and students face in accessing housing.
mission.text2: We connect hosts with a free room in their home with people looking for a place to live, fostering a coexistence based on companionship, mutual respect and everyday support.

values.title: What drives us
values.v1Text: We verify profiles and support the matching process between host and tenant so that the coexistence starts off on the right foot.
values.v2Text: We believe in the value of sharing everyday life across generations: you learn, you get support, and your quality of life improves.
values.v3Text: Every coexistence is a small step against unwanted loneliness and against the lack of affordable housing.

cta.title: Want to take part?
cta.subtitle: Find out whether you fit better as a host or as a tenant.

hero.title: Frequently asked questions
hero.subtitle: We answer the most common questions about Sempre na Casa.

q1.a: It's an intergenerational coexistence platform that connects hosts, who have a free room in their home, with tenants looking for accommodation, mainly students and young people.

q2.q: How does the matching process work?
q2.a: Hosts and tenants fill in a short survey about their habits and coexistence preferences. Our system calculates a compatibility percentage between homes and candidates to make it easier to get in touch.

q3.q: Does using the platform cost anything?
q3.a: Registering and basic use of the platform are free for both hosts and tenants.

q4.q: Who can register as a host?
q4.a: Anyone with a free room in their home who wants to share it and, optionally, receive help or company in return.

q5.q: Who can register as a tenant?
q5.a: Mainly students and young people looking for affordable housing and an enriching coexistence with a host.

q6.a: Every user registers with their personal and contact details, and the Sempre na Casa team reviews the homes and profiles registered on the platform.

q7.q: What happens if the coexistence doesn't work out?
q7.a: The host can report the tenant's departure from their dashboard at any time, and both parties can contact us if they need help resolving the situation.

q8.q: How can I contact the team?
q8.a: You can write to us from our contact page and we'll reply as soon as possible.
